card.name: Just before 'contraindicated' or 'not recommended'
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'is', 'also', 'therefore' and 'and' right before 'contraindicated' or 'not recommended' in drug interaction statements. Also fires inside the word 'contraindicated' and in 'Contraindications' cross-references.

modes.label: Verb before contraindicated
modes.description: The word 'is' or 'are' after a drug or drug class, just before 'contraindicated'.
modes.example: The concomitant use of Citalopram Oral Solution with MAOIs<< is>> contraindicated.

modes.label: Linking word before 'not'
modes.description: 'also' or 'therefore' placed before 'not be started' or 'not recommended'.
modes.example: Silodosin capsules are<< therefore>> not recommended in patients taking strong P-g

modes.label: Inside contraindicated
modes.description: Partway through the word contraindicated itself, even when spelled out in spaced letters.
modes.example: For products that are contr<<ain>>dicated with tranylcyprom

card.writes: Pushes the next word toward prohibition terms such as 'forbidden', 'contraindicated' and 'not suitable', mostly in Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a drug is said to be contraindicated or not recommended.
